The '''Tadrin sector''' was one of three [[Cassandran Worlds/Legends|Cassandran sectors]] created by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in Tadrin sector included [[Minashee/Legends|Minashee]] and [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]]. The [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Luthus Tadrin]], after [[Tadrin family|whose family]] it was named. Minashee was the sector capital.

The sector was [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invaded]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].
